query:
SELECT ci.cardName, ci.tier, ci.estimatedValue, ci.imageUrl as ciImage, mc.imageUrl as mcImage, mc.characterName
FROM checklist_items ci 
LEFT JOIN marvel_cards mc ON mc.characterName LIKE CONCAT('%', SUBSTRING_INDEX(ci.cardName, ' ', 2), '%')
WHERE ci.tier = 'chase' AND mc.imageUrl IS NOT NULL 
GROUP BY ci.cardName
ORDER BY ci.id ASC
LIMIT 10;
